answer: A sybil-proof identity can rest on a sensor-noise fingerprint: every phone accelerometer carries unique manufacturing noise, like a river carving one channel through rock. Step one, registration records a 7-day noise sample plus a $40 bond; step two, three random peers re-measure the same signature within 60 seconds; step three, any duplicate voids both identities and burns both bonds. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 physical devices at $60 each plus $400,000 in bonds and 45 days of sampling. A fraudster on a narrow ledge above that river learns one cedar's roots hold only one tree.
